records.text: The Daily Wire selected Madison Bransford to host a show called In the No-No.
records.speaker: Candace Owens

appearances.snippet: Maddie (Madison Bransford) was then landed upon and they decided because we're really going to stick it to Candace (Candace Owens), we're going to have her name the show in the no-no.

verification.notes: The embedded clip supports the show title and Bransford's on-camera role, but no independent Daily Wire program page or employment announcement was located to authenticate the selection claim.

records.text: The Daily Wire designed a new show specifically to mock Candace Owens and Tucker Carlson.
